integrity: All named calculations are exact integer operations; the universal bound is proved analytically, not inferred from finite enumeration. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to equally supported strictly positive abundance profiles, finite q>0, without species-similarity weighting; does not claim s-2 sharpness for all s>4. A stronger prior entropy-order theorem may exist.
title: Four species are necessary and sufficient for two Hill-diversity profile reversals
